notes.title: 1.3.0.0 IS ALIVE!! Magic Twins Update Summoned!!!
notes.content:
Hey there!

Abra and Cadabra unleashed Colormageddon and we are still working to improve the experience for all Magic Twins players (we love you!).

Many of the improvements in this patch come from your comments and impressions. Therefore, we want to thank you for helping us to make Magic Twins an even better game. You’re the best!

Oh, and two more language.

For more details, please find attached the patch notes!

Cheers!

1.3.0.0. Patch Notes
Reworked and improved game feel for our aweasome endless mode with new missions by time.

Added RUSSIAN and JAPANES languages.

NOW! Shared mind mode is unlocked when you complete the "special level" of these zone. In single player, the IA is most deficient than normal.

Balanced witch AI for Single Player Mode. Now your CPU witch will be smarter and defend its side of the scenario more effectively!

Several balancing fixes on several rituals (thanks a lot for your feedback!).


We love you!!

notes.title: MAGIC TWINS: STEPS TO PLAY ONLINE WITH STEAM REMOTE PLAY TOGETHER
notes.content:
[b]Abra:[/b] Cadabra! The Colormaggedon has been unleashed while you were on vacation away from Mallorca, and I don’t think I can stop it alone! What should we do?

[b]Cadabra:[/b] Don’t worry, Abra! I’ve got just the thing. We should totally use Steam Remote Play Together so I can help you with those color elementals plaguing the island.

[b]Abra:[/b] Remote what?

[b]Cadabra:[/b] Steam Remote Play! It’s a Steam feature that allows you to play co-op games together with your friends even if you’re not together in person!

[b]Abra:[/b] Okay, that sounds amazing, but… How do I set it up?

[b]Cadabra:[/b] Abra, what would you do without me? It’s very easy, just follow carefully the steps I’m going to tell you, okay?

[olist]
[*] Launch Magic Twins on Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37261344/53750d1d9967f7914c5e5a67e49e49cf3a63fc3d.png[/img]

[*] Once you reach the main menu, open your Steam overlay in-game (Shift+Tab).

[*] Invite your friend (or twin) to play! You have two ways of doing so:

[list]
[*] Click “Invite anyone to play” in your friend list. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37261344/4cff60a162b0c170eba557f60b0481734544b44d.png[/img]
[*] From here you will see two options:
[list]
[*] “Invite a Guest”: with this option you can invite anyone, even from outside Steam, by sharing a link with them. Click on “Add”, copy the link and send it to the person that you want to invite.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37261344/c2b0d743c2677b9a811789d0d2425ffbf85688ff.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37261344/9418405ea7a67bf13334c4876ddad039178dfebf.png[/img]
[*] “Invite a friend”: with this option you will be able to invite someone from your friend list. Just select them on the list that will open in front of you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37261344/184c25e0884b7cdd18b713c81cc0b98dbb1280f0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37261344/b9233db974dce8a388a78e8a8cc32d08441aa686.png[/img]
[/list]

[*] Go to your friend list, right click on the person you want to invite and select “Remote Play Together” in the menu that will come up.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37261344/f6b5c86fbd0bb175d5de798e2ba2a22272e6d6f5.png[/img]
[/list]

[*] Now your friend (or twin) must accept your invitation. Once it’s done, check on the Remote Play section of the Steam overlay that you have given them permission to use the keyboard and the controller, depending on their choice of controls to play.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37261344/b3817f683b19493ac589a89181f43efee283894b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37261344/423c36d332686a9fa9fbf41f834323634e9b4589.png[/img]

[*] Play, play, play!!! (Remotely) You’re now ready to dive into the island of Mallorca. But be careful: both of you can control the two characters with the keyboard, so make sure you don’t get in each other’s way!

[*] Or if you prefer it, you can also watch this video. It’ll tell you all you need to get Steam Remote Play Working!
[/olist]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qReG4RHCAeI

[b]Abra:[/b] Finally we can play even if we’re super far away from each other! Awesome! Now… Let the ritual begin!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270080/Magic_Twins/

notes.title: HAPPY HOLIDAYS FROM FLYING BEAST LABS!
notes.content:
On behalf of the entire team, we would like to thank you for the amazing support you have given to Abra and Cadabra. This year has been tough for everyone, but we are very happy to have seen how many people have joined us to enjoy Magic Twins and stop the Colormageddon (while getting some nice clothes).

That's why we wanted to take advantage of the #SteamWinterSale to make a small event. Just for playing Magic Twins from today (December 22nd) to January 5th, you will get an Incredibly Adorable Festive Skin!!!

And what better time than Christmas to get together with the family and play Magic Twins? Try not to shout at each other too much ;D

Have a great time! We'll see you next year with exciting new stuff!

- The Flying Beast Labs Team

notes.title: 1.2.0.0. - First Big Magic Twins Update Summoned!!!
notes.content:
Hey there!

It's been almost 3 months since Abra and Cadabra unleashed Colormageddon and we are still working to improve the experience for all Magic Twins players (we love you!).

Many of the improvements in this patch come from your comments and impressions. Therefore, we want to thank you for helping us to make Magic Twins an even better game. You’re the best!

The main enhancements have been to improve the single player experience, gamepad connectivity and Remote Play support. Oh, and three more languages from the Iberian Peninsula: Portuguese, Euskera and Mallorquín! Also, a real electric guitar!

For more details, please find attached the patch notes!

Cheers!

[h3][b]1.2.0.0. Patch Notes[/b][/h3]
[list] [*]Improved witch AI for Single Player Mode. Now your CPU witch will be smarter and defend its side of the scenario more effectively! [/list]
[list] [*]New Secret Single Player Mode added. An extra hard mode that will test your skill. Only for pro witches! [/list]
[list] [*]New Controller Window. Now the controllers can be changed manually, solving some connectivity issues (especially using Remote Play). [/list]
[list] [*]A particular theme from a particular ritual has been rerecorded with real electric guitars for extra epicness by the incomparable rocker guitarist and better person Asier Fernández Irazabal! [/list]
[list] [*]Portuguese, Euskera and Mallorquin languages added. More languages are on the way! [/list]
[list][*] Now chromas are correctly shown in the Map. Behold all those cute colors![/list]
[list] [*]Several balancing fixes on several rituals (thanks a lot for your feedback!). [/list]
[list] [*]Small adjustments in the Options Menu. [/list]
[list] [*]New texts have been added to support the new functionalities. [/list]
[list] [*]Lots of small bugs have been fixed. [/list]
[list] [*]AlmaDeFenix and Cronwen have been added to the Credits as testers because they deserve it ;D [/list]

notes.title: Magic Twins at Remote Play Together!
notes.content:
Join us at the Steam event [b]Remote Play Together[/b]! Talk with the devs and enjoy the live streaming! Stay tuned!


Magic Twins is a [b]game arcade puzzler cooperative[/b] in which Abra and Cadabra (the titular Magic Twins), must constantly swap their chromagic powers to defeat hordes of color elementals and stop the Colormageddon (which they unintentionally unleashed). Red beats red, blue beats blue.. you get the drill. Magic doesn't need to be complicated!

But spells are not enough! [b]Communication[/b] (and probably some yelling) will be invaluable to overcome all the challenges ahead of you: different objectives per level, final boss, multiple game modes, special events… Don't worry, we're sure you'll get some cute skins along the way.

At last a game that uses magic to combine the best of Puzzle Bobble, Plants vs Zombies and Overcooked with a spooky cute visual style!!
